name: app-root
description: Task runner for the whole repo. See CLAUDE.md for the workflow.

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm ci && cd ../e2e && npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && node scripts/unit-summary.mjs
scripts.migrations: cd backend && uv run python src/manage.py makemigrations && uv run python scripts/export_d1_migrations.py
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run check && npm run test:e2e
